text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Arm M4, mean of the weights refitted in October 2025, January 2026, April 2026, and June 2026, over three seeds. Each lead day has about 7,000 rows from 53 runs, so neighbouring lead days differ by more than a smooth weighting would.'
text.tspan: Arm M4, mean of the weights refitted in October 2025, January 2026, April 2026,
and June 2026, over three seeds. Each lead day has about 7,000 rows from 53
runs, so neighbouring lead days differ by more than a smooth weighting would.
